## Collaborator profiles (content-preserving Quarto adaptation)

For sections that do not map cleanly from Squarespace, a robust migration path is to represent each collaborator as a Quarto card/callout block, preserving text first and refining style later.

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
### Altug Didikoglu (IZTECH)
Member of the Chronobiology Laboratory research group and Assistant Professor in Neuroscience at IZTECH, focusing on sleep/circadian biology and real-world light exposure. Collaborates on field light-exposure measurement and analysis.

**Contact person:** Altug Didikoglu  
**Involved researcher:** Sema Nur Aydin
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
### KNUST team
KNUST (Kumasi, Ghana) contributes expertise from optometry and visual science, including work on environmental vision and personal light exposure characteristics.

**Contact person:** Kwadwo Owusu Akuffo
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
### Scienterra Ltd
Scienterra develops scientific UV instrumentation and contributes experience as equipment supplier and innovator in personal harmful-radiation exposure measurement.

**Contact person:** Zim Sherman
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
### sglux GmbH
sglux provides long-standing UV sensor development, production, and calibration expertise; contribution centers on practical dosimetry and sensor characterization.

**Contact person:** Niklas Papathanasiou
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
### SunSense
SunSense contributes expertise from portable UV tracking, including practical insights for UV dosimetry characterization in everyday settings.

**Contact person:** Åsulv Tønnesland
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
### University Hospital RWTH Aachen
Clinical and translational collaboration for light-exposure and dosimetry use cases.

**Contact:** See institutional webpage for team details.
:::
:::
:::
